lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.

lines: Bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad
couplets.en: After so long, memory stirs in us far from home.
We remember the soil of home.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.
My name is written on the outside.
Inside are these words.
You who went away to a foreign land.

lines: Laut ke phir na aane wale
couplets.en: You who never came back.
You went across seven seas.
You left us feeling dead while still alive.

lines: Khoon ke rishte tod gaya tu
couplets.en: You broke the ties of blood.

lines: Aankh mein aansoo chhod gaya tu
couplets.en: You left tears in our eyes.
We eat little.
We sleep little.
We spend so much of our time in tears.
A letter has come.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.

lines: Sooni ho gayi shehar ki galiyan
couplets.en: The lanes of town have fallen quiet.

lines: Kaante ban gayin baagh ki kaliyan
couplets.en: The garden buds have turned to thorns.
The monsoon swings seem to speak.

lines: Bhool gaya tu, hum nahin bhoole
couplets.en: You forgot, and we still remember.
Diwali came while you were away.

lines: Deep nahin, dil jale hain khaali
couplets.en: Only our hearts burned, and the lamps stayed dark.
Holi came while you were away.
The spray of colour felt like a gunshot.
The peepal stands deserted, and so does the well.
The house has grown as still as a cremation ground.
The harvest was cut, and Baisakhi came.
We were still waiting for you to come.
A letter has come.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.

lines: Pehle jab tu khat likhta tha
couplets.en: In the days when you used to write.
We could see your face in the paper.

lines: Band hua ye mel bhi ab to
couplets.en: Even that small meeting has come to an end.

lines: Khatm hua ye khel bhi ab to
couplets.en: Even that little game is over now.
Your sister sat in her bridal palanquin.
Her eyes were still on the road.

lines: Main to baap hoon, mera kya hai
couplets.en: I am your father, so never mind me.

lines: Teri maa ka haal bura hai
couplets.en: Your mother is faring poorly.
Your wife looks after us.
She wears the look of a widow.
You earned a great deal of money.
That money took you away from home.
Leave that foreign land and come home.
Little bird, break open your cage and come home.
Leave that foreign land and come home.
Little bird, break open your cage and come home.
Life is very short.

lines: Apne ghar mein bhi hai roti
couplets.en: There is bread for you at home too.
A letter has come.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.

lines: Bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad
couplets.en: After so long, memory stirs in us far from home.
We remember the soil of home.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter at last.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.
So many days have passed.
We who are far from home begin to remember.
We remember the soil of home.

lines: Aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai
couplets.en: It has come, the letter has come.
A letter has come.
A letter has come from home.
